horoscope: Mercury moves into the sector of your solar chart that rules your intimate world, long-term strategies, work on the self, investigations, and attraction to that which is hidden or taboo, dear Aries. This cycle will last longer than usual–until December 6th. You may be busy thinking about deeper issues or handling financial or accounting matters. Mercury here also brings more objectivity to complicated, deep-rooted feelings and complex situations, as its energy is quite objective! You may be doing some valuable research or investigation in the period ahead. It's a time of common sense with finances. It’s also a good cycle for deep, engaging conversations with others, as well as self-discovery. You’re inclined to observe more than participate mentally during this cycle—your curiosity grows around all things complicated, taboo, mysterious, and unresolved. Today should be strong on social and communicative levels, as you confidently reach out to others in creative, compassionate, and affectionate ways. While the day can be busy, it's likely to be a peaceful state of busy.

With Mercury's move into your partnership sector, dear Taurus, you thrive on communicating with others in the weeks ahead, especially in one-on-one scenarios. People may often rev up your thinking, and even if you don't always take their advice, you can still benefit from their feedback. In general, you're more inclined to weigh the pros and cons, negotiate, and discuss matters during this cycle. It's an excellent mental exercise, but there will be many times when you're saying things from your head and not your heart, which can bring mixed results! Remind yourself of healthy communication patterns. You seem to have a stronger need for intellectual stimulation through others until December 6th, and you may often seek someone to share your ideas and decision-making process with. This Mercury cycle lasts longer than the usual three weeks, and this is because Mercury will later turn retrograde (from October 24th to November 13th). Today, you may be discovering ways to boost your sense of security. It's a fine time to decorate, organize, and otherwise bring more energy to the home.

Your planetary ruler, Mercury, enters your solar sixth house today, dear Gemini. During this transit, which lasts until December 6th, you'll place greater emphasis on daily routines, work, health, and self-care or self-improvement programs. It's a good time for putting effort into organizing your work and workspace, and for seeking out information that helps you improve your health, habits, and daily routines. It's an excellent time to read, write, and discuss your work and patterns, and also to develop or brush up on necessary skills. Take in as much as you can, but also make time to sort out small problems and details. Mercury here is particularly suitable for improved analysis and organization. Work itself can keep you especially busy or may require extra attention to detail and precise communication. Tidying up your daily routines and improving habits can do wonders for you now. Today, the Moon moves into your sign and harmonizes well, helping you find satisfying channels for self-expression. You have a zest for action today, and you have much personal presence.

Mercury enters your solar fifth house today, dear Cancer, encouraging you to share your ideas and create beautiful things until December 6th. Your desire to be heard and seen as unique is set to grow. There can be a stronger focus on creative endeavors, children, romance, entertainment, and pastimes. Mercury is strong here for creative intelligence and expressing your ideas in more innovative, dynamic ways. Spontaneous conversation or learning can be in focus and extraordinarily beneficial. People may be drawn to your mind and intelligence, or you may connect with others who are especially interesting. This cycle seems to create an overall easier flow of communication and a mental focus on pleasure, fun, romance, entertainment, and creativity. You're more inclined to play games, take some risks with your communications, joke, think about or analyze your love life, and express your affections verbally. It's a good cycle for writing, entertaining, creating, and expressing yourself. Today, support comes from behind the scenes or from within. You'll benefit from some personal time and space now.

The messenger planet, Mercury, begins its transit of the sector of your solar chart that rules heart, home, and family today, dear Leo. Mercury will stay here for longer than usual, until December 6th. The period ahead is likely to be quite busy in your personal life or with family. There can be increased activity on the home front or valuable lessons from loved ones. A stronger focus on tradition, security, and the home is in store. You may be doing a little more work at, on, or from home, and perhaps entertaining. You can also express yourself more with the people closest to you. You may not feel the need to reach out and connect with unfamiliar people as much, preferring to connect with family and loved ones. This is a generally good time for beginning new long-term projects. Even so, Mercury will later (on the 24th) retrograde in this same sector, perhaps prompting a redo, rethink, or delay on projects begun in the first week of October and beyond. Today, you may feel connected emotionally and spiritually with people in your life. There is a stronger ability to understand people's unspoken feelings or states of mind now.

Mercury enters your solar third house today, dear Virgo, and will visit here until December 6th. Mercury is your planetary ruler, and it always helps when it's harmonizing with your sign--you get a nice little boost. This transit furthers a theme in your life of learning, transportation, making contact and connections, and getting out and about. Your social life is likely to improve, your mind is even sharper than usual, and keeping or getting in touch with others can lead to valuable opportunities. However, you may not have enough time (or possibly interest) for in-depth study or focus during this cycle. This trend is better for connecting you with new information, ideas, and interests. You're in an exceptional position for feeling out new ideas and situations, for improving your communications with others, and for picking up handy tips and info. Learning, speaking, writing, and transportation matters are in focus and generally good shape during this cycle that lasts all the way until December 6th. Still, Mercury will be retrograde for part of this period (from October 24th to November 13th), which can complicate matters. Today, you're more aware of the impact you're making with the Moon's move to the top of your solar chart, sensitizing you to your performance and what others may be thinking. Your sense of responsibility heightens, but while you're motivated to get a grip on your priorities, it's also important to make time for relaxation.

Mercury leaves your sign and enters your solar second house today, dear Libra, and will stick around here for longer than usual, until December 6th. It's a period of special attention to your security and comfort needs, money matters, and sense of value. You're thinking more often about your practical affairs or in practical terms during this period. It's a great time for thinking about improvements to business pursuits and for organizing your finances since Mercury's energy is objective. With Venus already in this area of your solar chart, you'll now see even more emphasis on sticking with the status quo, cultivating patience, and working on building your resources. It's a time for patient planning. This is also one of the best Mercury cycles for building and growing your natural talents. It's a great time to focus on what truly needs attention, as you're less likely to get distracted. You're attracted to useful information and hands-on learning. Today is good for feeling at ease with others and for flowing moments of sharing. Teaching and learning may be in focus and are likely to come quite naturally. Activities that allow you to give physical form to your feelings can appeal.

Mercury moves into your sign today, dear Scorpio, and the pace of your life picks up. You're likely to feel more connected and engaged. It's a time for making more executive decisions, as you're less inclined to seek others' feedback during this cycle that lasts all the way until December 6th. You keep yourself busy and crave more variety and movement in your life now. You're open to new ideas and interests, and your words have more impact than usual. Your decisions also come more readily and spontaneously. You can be a friend magnet at this time with the ruler of your social sector now in your sign. You have a stronger desire to express yourself by speaking your mind. Doing some self-directed learning can be in focus during this period. Today, you're paying more attention to your deeper feelings. If you have some research to do or your endeavors and interests can benefit from some deeper insight or strategy, you’re in particularly good shape now.

Mercury heads into your privacy sector today, dear Sagittarius, closing up a communications cycle. It will spend longer than the usual three weeks in this area of your solar chart, however. Instead, it will visit until December 6th before moving into your sign. It's an excellent time to assess or re-assess recent projects and interests. You could find yourself tying up loose ends on a project or study. It may be a time for looking back, behind you, or within for answers. You're less likely to seek others' counsel in the weeks ahead, but they may frequently request yours! It's a strong time for contemplation, meditation, research, and behind-the-scenes work or study. You may be a little less accessible than usual, as you might retreat more often to gain perspective. Your powers of observation are boosted as you see the world through a different lens. It's a time of more impressionability and sensitivity. Today, close relationships are on your mind, and you tend to thrive on others' input, whether or not you actually use it! It's a good time for socializing.

Mercury enters your social sector today, dear Capricorn, where it will transit for longer than its usual three weeks in a sector, until December 6th. You're shifting your focus to networking, community, your social life, happiness goals, and special projects and causes. You're giving more thought to fulfilling happiness goals, making contact, and reaching out to like-minded people. It's a time to enjoy and benefit from sharing ideas with friends and associates. You seek out intelligent and interesting company now. Sharing ideas with others tends to help jumpstart or clarify your thinking during this cycle. Today's energies are good for catching your bearings. You have good energy working for you to research a topic more thoroughly. You'll have a stronger sense of where you're headed in terms of work and career goals now, but try not to force thinking on these fronts, as it's better to let ideas flow naturally.

Mercury begins its transit of your career and reputation sector today, dear Aquarius. In the period ahead, you're likely to think and/or talk about life plans, career goals, opportunities, and responsibilities. Mercury is analytical and rational, and you're applying these qualities to these things, but when under strain, Mercury can also be nervous and fretful. It's a good time to spread the word and promote your work or services. Your ideas or advice can be in higher demand in the weeks ahead. Your smarts and know-how help you advance during this cycle, or you're taking in especially valuable information that helps you further your goals or improve your career and business. With increased awareness of how you're coming across, you may be taking more care with your communications. Your thinking is especially goal-oriented and practical. This cycle will last longer than usual, until December 6th. Today, relationships feel more straightforward, and you get a sense that things are moving along well.

Mercury enters your solar ninth house for an extended stay, dear Pisces, and you'll notice a clear trend in your life that fuels your need for a change of pace, experiences beyond the ordinary and mundane, and a hunger for learning. This Mercury transit stirs your curiosity, and perhaps some mental restlessness at times. It's a good cycle for communicating, although it's better for personal interests and motivation than for attention to detail or practical affairs. You are more hopeful and optimistic, as well as spontaneous and free with your ideas and thoughts. You have the power to inspire and help others with your words or encouragement. You're looking for the purpose behind what you're learning, and you're particularly intuitive and visionary at this time. It's an excellent cycle for stretching your thinking and entertaining new possibilities, and it will stick with you until December 6th. Today, you can benefit from tuning out distractions and finding some time for yourself. You are finding comfort in familiar settings, and it can be a good time for home and family matters.
